movement: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production 2D game sprite atlas from the attached creature reference. Reference is character identity only: golden ochre fox quadruped, very long pointed ears with dark brown interiors, cream forehead tuft, huge shaggy cream neck mane, dark brown stripes on back and flanks, enormous bushy ochre tail with cream tip and dark brown stripe, black eyes, dark clean outlines. Preserve mature slender quadruped proportions. All face RIGHT, side view, consistent character size. Transparent background, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows, no effects. EXACT grid 6 columns x 5 rows, 30 separate full body poses, generous clear margins in each equal sized cell, no overlap. Canvas landscape 1536x1280 if possible. Each row is six sequential animation frames left to right. Row 1 idle breathing ear and tail sway; row 2 full running gait with alternating front/rear leg contacts and airborne extension; row 3 jump anticipation crouch then leap and tucked airborne legs; row 4 falling with legs extending for landing; row 5 landing compression then recover to standing. Character body stays anchored at same center and baseline per cell. High quality hand drawn cel shaded game art matching reference. Remove all reference annotations.
